summary: Iteration 5 (Public reviews + Restaurant info + Thermal receipt with QR codes) tested end-to-end. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases passed (public restaurant-info, GET /reviews/order/:id, POST /reviews/public/:id w/ rating validation + duplicate-prevention, regression for auth /reviews + Smart-Order-Alert + extended /track fields). Frontend: ReviewPage submission + already-reviewed-on-reload flow verified. OrderSuccessPage qr-find-us links to https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=31.452,74.268 and qr-leave-review links to /review/:id with both QR SVGs rendered. AdminOrders Print Invoice mounts ThermalReceipt as a portal under document.body containing restaurant name, address, phone, Order #, Date, Customer, Phone, Subtotal, TOTAL, Thank-you footer, FIND US + RATE ORDER QR sections (2 SVGs). window.print invoked exactly once and receipt unmounts ~800ms later. @media print stylesheet correctly hides body siblings (3/4 non-receipt body children become display:none in print emulation). Smart-Order-Alert UI (audio, mute, filter chips, modify modal) still works.

integration_issues.issue: Submit button is disabled when rating=0, so the 'Please select a rating' toast triggered inside submit() never actually fires because the click is a no-op. Functionally fine (user cannot submit invalid rating), but the toast guard is dead code.

action_items: (LOW) ReviewPage.jsx submit(): either remove the disabled={!rating} on the button OR remove the toast.error('Please select a rating') guard since they conflict (toast never shows because button is disabled).

(INFO) Consider adding the customer's order items + total inside the QR-leave-review block on OrderSuccessPage so the receipt context is visible there too — currently shown only on the success page (already present).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 3174 lines (up from 3079). Strongly recommend splitting routers (auth, menu, online_orders, online_orders_alerts, tracking, public, reviews, settings) — exceeds 700-line guideline.
GET /api/reviews/order/{id} uses ObjectId(...) inside try/except returning 404 for any invalid id — good pattern.
POST /api/reviews/public/{id} correctly limits comment to 500 chars and customer_name to 60 — good defensive truncation.
Public review duplicate check uses {order_id: order_id} only (no customer_id), correctly enforcing one-review-per-order regardless of who submits.
/api/public/restaurant-info has hardcoded fallback lat/lng (31.452, 74.268) — fine for now but should be moved into a seed/migration so it's discoverable.
ThermalReceipt is correctly mounted via createPortal(node, document.body) — print-stylesheet rule body>*:not(.receipt-print){display:none} works as intended.
AdminOrders.handlePrint hits PUT /online-orders/{id}/printed asynchronously without awaiting — fine; UI immediately updates on next poll.
ReviewPage.jsx: name initial value taken from order.customer_name — nice UX touch.
OrderSuccessPage falls back to maps.google.com if /api/public/restaurant-info fails — reasonable resilience.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed online orders during pytest setup (TEST_ReviewerOne, TEST_ReviewerTwo) and one frontend review-flow order id 69fc5fa1dd3ae0ceb9500a1d (TEST_FE_Customer) with a public review submitted by TEST_PW_Reviewer (rating 5).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Iteration-5 features verified. Public review endpoint allows ONE review per order; second attempt returns 400 'already reviewed'. Restaurant info endpoint returns sane defaults if settings doc missing. ThermalReceipt is portaled under document.body — search by `[data-testid='thermal-receipt']` (NOT inside the AdminOrders root). Receipt is removed ~800ms after Print click (300ms + 500ms). Use /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5_reviews.py as the iter-5 regression suite. Login response uses key `token` (not `access_token`), and online-orders POST requires {item_id, name, price, quantity} per item plus a top-level total_price. Pending count endpoint returns {pending_count, latest_id, latest_at} — note key name.
rca of the issue: No bugs requiring RCA found in this iteration. The only finding is a minor logical redundancy in ReviewPage.jsx where toast.error('Please select a rating') is unreachable because the submit button is also disabled when rating=0. Either the disabled attribute or the toast guard should be removed for code clarity.
